Introduction

Minji is a South Korean singer under O2Clean. She is a former member of the girl group Busters. In November of 2019, it was announced that Minji had left the group due to personal reasons.

O2Clean announced that Minji had signed an artist contract with them on March 3, 2020. She later released her first solo single on November 17, 2021.
